## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] New or changed generators have a multi-seed uniqueness test per tier
- [ ] Engine code stays pure: no React, no DOM, no `Math.random`
- [ ] Visuals use `DESIGN.md` tokens; motion is transform and opacity only and respects reduced motion
- [ ] Product or design decisions logged in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, `docs/ROADMAP.md` ticked
